query:
SELECT
                kb.user_id,
                COALESCE(kb.backup_id_text, kb.version::text) AS "backup_id!",
                bk.room_id,
                bk.session_id,
                bk.first_message_index,
                bk.forwarded_count,
                bk.is_verified,
                bk.session_data
            FROM backup_keys bk
            JOIN key_backups kb ON kb.backup_id = bk.backup_id
            WHERE kb.user_id = $1
              AND (kb.backup_id_text = $2 OR kb.version::text = $2)
              AND bk.room_id = ANY($3)
